name: @btkulka/http-kit
description: The fetch plumbing Ben's API clients share: FetchLike types and a default fetch, a typed HttpError, one request with a per-attempt timeout and AbortSignal that reads text first and parses JSON when it can, retries (429 waits Retry-After, 5xx and network errors back off, never an abort), an abortable sleep, UTF-8 safe base64, a Basic auth header and form encoding. Browser-safe: no node:* imports, no Buffer. No runtime dependencies.
